body:
New state should be added here to be accessible for property inspector.

There's also similar code in `MenuButton` to forward the state to the underlying `PopupMenu`.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/e82870e250a326c94e03d658306db94e1b116c2d/scene/gui/menu_button.cpp#L223
I would also unset `checked` if `indeterminate` is set to true here (and the same for indeterminate in the `set_checked`), since these aren't compatible states.

body: The description could mention that the item can't be both in selected and indeterminate state.
